text: Student Summer Training One of ITIDA's Human Capital Development Programs (HCDP) "Student Summer Training," one of ITIDA's Human Capital Development Programs (HCDP), began in 2014. It offers hands-on training on the up-to-the-minute technology trends for the students. This summer practice considers increasing the students' capacities and well prepares them to the IT market post-graduation. Overview Students' Summer Internship is one of the Human Capacity Development Programs launched by the Information Technology Industry Development Agency (ITIDA) in 2014. The program provides free practical training on the latest technology trends for the students. It aims to build students' capacities and prepare them to work in the IT market after graduation.

In this Summer Internship program, ITIDA collaborates with telecom and technology companies through Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives. It also works with the National Telecommunication Institute (NTI) for its wide technical training experience and diverse partnerships with multiple global tech companies. ITIDA offers two summer training programs: 1. ITIDA – NTI Joint Summer Training Program The ITIDA-NTI Summer Training program consists of two main tracks and lasts for 120 hours total: • Technical Skills Track – duration: 90 hours • Soft Skills / Freelance Track – duration: 30 hours This training program covers all the governorates of Egypt geographically.
